formalEvidence.scope: Synthetic rule-boundary tests against the frozen public contract. No complete ordinary route, private author witness, browser execution, rendering performance, or physical-device testing is claimed.

independentReview.method: Independent exact horizontal-band sweep and interval-set algebra; absolute-tick piecewise origin/mirror/strip formulas; original held inputs and transaction-local aperture/film/credit receipts. No production import, replay, search or new gameplay.
limitations: Only the six existing public ordinary cases; unencountered last-sheet wins, clipping/occlusion/mirror boundaries, cancellation and dt/error inputs are not claimed as ordinary coverage.
Geometric equality is partition-independent, while record copies and provenance bindings preserve exact actual JSON values. All integer geometry, gates, film and time comparisons use zero tolerance.

Input checks cover recorded ordinary held-key samples and their documented normalization/repeat congruence; browser event delivery, pause/retry, video, rendering, object identity and runtime Object.freeze are not established by JSON observations.
Next-interval exposure counters use the saved actual photo and the actually retained returned scene, evaluated against that photo target; no future predicted state or hypothetical route is counted.
Original raw source hashes are inherited from the root-reviewed lossless public manifest; original diagnostic-bearing files and production implementations are not read.

candidateNormalPlay.scope: Only actual public observations, permanent photographs and ordered target credits. Sparse browser trace is not a complete 60 Hz stream. A terminal shutter transaction has no motion interval. Saved exposure and expected target belong to that receipt; live preview belongs to the later current state. Current-frame predicates do not predict a shot. Menu prime never advances the model; screenshots never pause or force state.

gameRules.scope: Bind actual film balances, permanent capture-time geometry and targets, zero-interval terminal transactions and source reports. The complete ordinary geometry audit is separate; this release check runs no Model, planner, new game or missing-motion reconstruction.

modelTests.scope: Synthetic rule-boundary tests against the frozen public contract. No complete ordinary route, private author witness, browser execution, rendering performance, or physical-device testing is claimed.

checks.name: P freezes gameplay state and tick, P resumes
R restarts with clean simulation state
resizing keeps canvas and complete sidebar text visible
no page, console or resource errors
three menus show ordered fixed-orientation targets, components and frame modes without hiding controls
held START starts once; phone A and native Enter each expose exactly one photograph
held B changes frame mode once without film use; neutral rearm admits the next real toggle
cancel and partial neutral suppress stale frame and shutter inputs while actual scene motion continues
disconnect freezes every model field; explicit resume suppresses stale navigation and resumes actual motion
P freezes the moving scene, current aperture and saved photograph; small blueprint and sidebar remain complete
ordinary public L1 empty-film policy naturally exhausts the last sheet without a motion interval
R restores the same scenario, film and target order, with empty photo history and naturally advancing initial motion
separate QR room-info layout fixture fits complete text at both TV sizes

rule.text: 三片完整入窗 · 不可遮挡 · 朝向固定 · 依序拍摄

geometry.origin: world upper-left; x increases right, y increases down
geometry.cellRegion: cell [x,y] denotes the half-open rectangle [480*x,480*(x+1)) by [480*y,480*(y+1)); geometry is the exact union of those rectangles
geometry.boundaryRule: shared edges have zero overlap; exact containment at an aperture edge is accepted
geometry.mirrorRule: reflect a shape within its fixed published widthCells: local cell x becomes widthCells-1-x; no automatic reflection, rotation or recentering is allowed during matching
geometry.registration: target coordinates are fixed relative to the exposure window's upper-left; each identified required actor must exactly equal its own target region in that coordinate frame
geometry.humanMargin: window movement is in exact one-cell steps; successful scene poses dwell, so exposure timing has a multi-second interval rather than a one-tick coincidence
geometry.occluderTone: opaque illuminated paper, replacing ink with background in a photograph
geometry.fullVisibility: every required actor's complete world region must lie inside world and aperture, and no part may intersect any higher opaque actor or the foreground paper strip
geometry.sameColorOverlap: overlap still occludes the lower actor even if display colors are similar; visible component tints and seams identify the three required parts
geometry.exposure: compose back-to-front inside the aperture; required actors deposit ink and the paper strip overwrites covered ink with paper; compare the entire resulting local ink set to the target union
geometry.match: correct frame mode AND exact per-required-actor local region equality AND complete visibility of every required actor AND exact full exposure union equality

aperture.centerLattice: odd integer doubled-cell coordinates; one navigation step changes one center coordinate by 2
aperture.clampRule: for width w and height h in cells, clamp centerX2 to [w,56-w] and centerY2 to [h,32-h]
aperture.modeChange: B toggles landscape/portrait, keeps the center, then clamps that center to the new mode's legal range
aperture.board: the opaque player board blocks the world outside the exposure rectangle; it does not translate the stage or the target geometry

motion.poseWorldOrigin: actor origin at pose k is 480*(pose.stageOriginCells + pose.parts[actorId].originCells)
motion.translation: linear exact integer-origin interpolation over 480 ticks; all waypoint differences are whole cells so each per-tick velocity is an integer number of units
motion.mirrorDuringTransit: use fromPose mirror state for transit ages 0..239 and toPose mirror state for ages 240..479; this is an explicit instantaneous paper-holder reversal at the transit midpoint
motion.segmentBoundary: segments are [from,to); endpoint positions agree; phase 0 is pose 2's exact position and mirror state at the start of its departing transit

occluder.dwellRule: move linearly from start to exit during the first 60 dwell ticks, then remain at exit through the dwell end
occluder.transitRule: during each 480-tick actor transit, move linearly from the previous pose's exit origin to the next pose's dwell-start origin
occluder.guaranteedClearDwellInterval: closed capture interval [dwellStart+60,dwellEnd], lasting 180 ticks and containing 181 integer capture boundaries; at dwellEnd the next transit has the same endpoint geometry, with no strip overlap with the whole aperture

performance.note: Intervals between observer RAF callbacks on this browser; not render CPU time or device FPS. WebGL multi_draw counts API submissions, not its subdraws. Canvas paint commands are not GPU draw calls. OffscreenCanvas workers are not observed.

actualGameplay.scope: Actual shutter/mode key edges, immutable photographs with their original captured scene/target, ordered credits and sparse live geometry. Photo and credit banks are copied without deriving a future exposure. Transactions and real motion intervals are separately deduplicated; terminal capture has no interval and host ticks remain distinct. Local copy/film/endpoint checks do not replace the separate complete ordinary geometry audit. Snapshot indices bind live-versus-saved comparisons; missed transient lastPhoto/frame-change updates and motion gaps remain explicit. No missing motion, mirror transition, shape, input or shot is reconstructed. Menu preparation never advances the model.

candidateAttemptHistory.scope: Preserved first candidate menu-only assertion failure and targeted visible-label-bounds correction; production unchanged. This is candidate history, not a recording failure, rerun, or recovery claim.

encodedObservationAnchors.scope: Nine unmodified encoded images from actual periodic observations: three stable menus, moving exposure before any photograph, the first saved photograph, a portrait live window beside its saved wide photograph, the second saved photograph, later actual movement under the final target, and observed win after at least two seconds of terminal hold. Saved photographs are identified only by permanent photoReceipts and their original target, never by transaction-local lastPhoto or the current preview. No image claims the instantaneous shutter boundary. Host tick, mechanical tick and transaction count remain distinct. A missing sample stops extraction; no post-dispatch edge selection, predicted capture time, extra Model run or recapture. Original reception order and complete stable encoding-order mapping remain bound. Every image semantic awaits personal review.

hardware.note: Software Chromium with ordinary input. Synthetic fixtures are labelled separately; export FPS is not device FPS.
